description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lasswell], [Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon Damage Tracker], [Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon Level] to the user

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lasswell
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon (0~2), removed after using Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon two times

description.name: Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lasswell]

description.name: Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Mirror of Equity: Ice Demon level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Lasswell]
